test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

Hari said to the boy, "What's the matter? Why are you crying? Be cheerful."

options.text: Hari asked the boy what the matter was and why he was crying. He asked him to be cheerful.
Hari asks the boy what the matter was and why he was crying. He asks him to be cheerful.
Hari asked the boy what the matter was and why he was crying. He asks him to be cheerful.
Hari asked the boy what was the matter and he was crying. He asked him to be cheerful.

solution:
The correct answer is "**Hari asked the boy what the matter was and why he was crying**. **He asked him to be cheerful**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In indirect speech, the reporting verb (said) is changed to asked and the conjunction that is used is usually 'what' or 'if'.**
 
• The tense of the reported speech is changed to match the tense of the reporting verb.
 
 
• "Said" will be changed to "asked."
 
 
 
• The pronouns also changes depending on the context of the sentence.
 
 
• "You" changes to "he."
 
 
 
• Now, among the given options:
 
 
• In option 1, the tense of the sentence as well as the meaning of the sentence is kept intact.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** Incorrect tense is used in the reported speech.
 
• **Option 3:** The present tense is used instead of the past tense in the reported speech.
 
• **Option 4:** The sentence is not grammatically correct as 'he was crying' is not a question.
